remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)

add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0600
    -DWINVER=0x0600)

include_directories(${VKD3D_INCLUDE_DIRS})

spec2def(d3d11.dll d3d11.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# d3d11.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/d3d11-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(d3d11_shims OBJECT async.c buffer.c d3d11_main.c decoder.c device.c inputlayout.c shader.c state.c texture.c utils.c view.c)
target_link_libraries(d3d11_shims PRIVATE wine dxguid dx10guid uuid oldnames libdxgi libd3dwine libgdi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(d3d11_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_wine_module(d3d11_shims)
add_dependencies(d3d11_shims wineheaders d3d_idl_headers)
add_cargo_module(d3d11 d3d11-cargo d3d11.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS d3d11_shims psdk d3d_idl_headers uuid_sources)
